content: Honey, do you know what color the carrot is?
Wow, my son is so clever.
I am not a child at all. I know more.
Oh, my son looks like a grown-up.
Sure. Mom, I can take care of you.
No kidding. So tell me what's your favorite color?
I like blue. You see, that's the color of the sky. I wanna be a superman.
I hope I can fly to any place like superman. So I can touch the sky.
OK, superman. Put on your cape, we are going to fly home.
